meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理化学分子数据，计算描述符和指纹。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在药物发现中处理分子结构并计算属性。
copy.tagline_en: Process chemical molecular data, compute descriptors and fingerprints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle molecular structures and compute properties in drug discovery.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可借助 datamol 处理化学分子：解析 SMILES、标准化、算性质与指纹、聚类、生成 3D 构象、画图等。分子对象与 RDKit 兼容。
howto.when: 当用户需要处理化学分子时触发，如解析 SMILES/SDF、计算分子性质、比较相似性等。

say.text: 帮我把这些 SMILES 转成标准分子结构并画出来。
say.note: 会用 datamol 解析并可视化。

say.text: 计算这组分子的理化性质，再按相似度聚类。
say.note: 会并行计算描述符并聚类。

say.text: 用 datamol 生成这个分子的 3D 构象。
say.note: 会生成多个构象并返回。

howto.what_en: Claude can use datamol to handle molecules: parse SMILES, standardize, compute descriptors/fingerprints, cluster, generate 3D conformers, and visualize. Outputs are native RDKit objects.
howto.when_en: When the user needs to analyze chemical molecules, e.g., parsing SMILES/SDF, computing properties, or comparing similarity.

say_en.text: Convert these SMILES to standard structures and draw them.
say_en.note: It will parse and visualize with datamol.

say_en.text: Compute properties for these molecules and cluster by similarity.
Generate 3D conformers for this molecule using datamol.
